biography.content: Ilse Marten is a fictional composer whose chamber works open the Mujin Music sandbox.
Northbound Brass is a fictional nine-piece brass band.
Sora Ueda is a fictional pianist from Kanazawa.
Mara Vell is a fictional songwriter, on Qobuz as on TIDAL.
